purpose: Teach: 泙/蹐/癲/腓/磴/曚/儖/蕁

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の水音、つまり泙の証言を、警察、慎重に検証されますね
lines.en: So the case will require careful police verification of the scene evidence—the witness statements, that is.
lines.style: Measured, methodical. Slight pause before clarifying the parenthetical. Engaged but observational, like thinking through a procedural checklist aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の跼蹐、つまり蹐の態度を、警察、観察されますね
lines.en: Right. The police will observe the suspect's physical bearing—their comportment and attitude, specifically.
lines.style: Professional and affirming. Direct eye contact. Steady cadence. A confirmation that matches Ren's rhythm without losing official composure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被疑者の癲癇、つまり癲の発作歴も、警察、医師と確認されますね
lines.en: And the case will need police confirmation with a medical professional regarding the suspect's seizure history.
lines.style: Thoughtful, methodical. Slight weight on 'medical'—acknowledging the shift to specialist input. Even pace, careful articulation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の腓腹、つまり腓の打撲痕も鑑識されますね
lines.en: Of course. Forensic examination will document the victim's injury marks—particularly the bruising, for the record.
lines.style: Formal but grounded. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Professional tone that signals this detail matters to the case integrity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の磴、つまり石段から落下した経緯を、警察、調べられますね
lines.en: The case will also require police investigation into how the fall from the stone steps actually occurred.
lines.style: Calm, systematic. Slight lean forward on 'how'—this is the crux. Measured pace. Quietly insistent.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、夕暮れの曚、つまり曚気時の目撃の証言を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: Certainly. Police will gather witness statements from those present at dusk—clarifying what they saw in that light.
lines.style: Assured and precise. Measured delivery. Each phrase lands. Professional but warmer than before—acknowledging the logistical reality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の儖、つまり儖の体型特徴を、警察、目撃者に確認されますね
lines.en: The case will require confirming the victim's physical characteristics with witnesses—height, build, distinguishing features.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Slight emphasis on 'characteristics'—switching to a practical detail. Clear enunciation. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、緊急時の蕁麻疹、つまり蕁発症者への対応も配慮されますね
lines.en: Police will also take care in responding to any medical conditions that may arise during this process.
lines.style: Gentle but official. Slightly softer tone here—acknowledging human factors. Slower pace on medical considerations. Compassionate professionalism.
